inbody.title: InBody report
inbody.hubIntro: Snap your InBody report or upload the PDF. We read the numbers, analyse them and build a workout & meal plan that fits your body.
inbody.readingHint: Extracting the numbers, just a few seconds.
inbody.aiUnavailable: We couldn't read the report automatically. Enter the key numbers manually (takes a minute).
inbody.notInbody: This doesn't look like an InBody report. Try a clearer photo of the full sheet.
inbody.howToRead: How to read an InBody report
inbody.reviewHint: Check the numbers before saving; fields marked * are needed for the analysis.
inbody.missing: Enter at least weight, muscle mass and body fat
inbody.applying: Building your plan from the report…
inbody.appliedDone: Done! Your new plan is based on your InBody report
inbody.segmentalHint: Percent of normal for each segment (100% = normal)
inbody.improvePlanHint: More accurate calories, protein and training focus

insight.ecw_high: Your ECW ratio {{v}} is above normal (0.36–0.39), which may indicate edema or fluid retention. Please see a doctor; your plan uses moderate intensity until then.
insight.visceral_high: Visceral fat is high ({{v}}). This fat around the organs carries more health risk, so we added regular cardio and cut sugars.
insight.visceral_normal: Visceral fat is in the normal range 👍
insight.fat_very_high: Body fat {{v}}% is well above range. Priority: gradual fat loss while protecting muscle.
insight.fat_high: Body fat {{v}}% is above the normal range.
insight.fat_low: Body fat {{v}}% is below range; don't cut food — focus on building.
insight.fat_normal: Body fat {{v}}% is in the normal range.
insight.muscle_low: Muscle mass {{v}} kg is below range; we raised protein and prioritised resistance training.
insight.muscle_high: Muscle mass {{v}} kg is excellent and above range 💪
insight.muscle_normal: Muscle mass {{v}} kg is in range.
insight.weak_segments: Below-normal segments: {{list}}. We added extra work for them.
insight.imbalance_arms: {{v}}% difference between arms; we added one-arm exercises starting with the weaker side.
insight.imbalance_legs: {{v}}% difference between legs; we added one-leg exercises starting with the weaker side.
insight.upper_weaker: Upper body is relatively weaker than lower; we increased upper-body volume.
insight.lower_weaker: Lower body is relatively weaker than upper; we added more leg work.
insight.target: Per your report: target weight {{target}} kg (fat {{fat}} kg, muscle {{muscle}} kg) — about {{weeks}} weeks.
insight.bmr: Measured BMR {{v}} kcal; we used it instead of an estimate and your calories won't go below it.

changes.calories: Calories from the BMR measured in your report
changes.protein: Protein based on your fat-free mass
changes.ecw: Moderate intensity and a medical check

inbody.disclaimer: Fitness guidance only, not a medical diagnosis.

health.title: Your Pulse
health.zone_none: Connect a watch to measure recovery
health.connectBody: We read your steps, sleep and heart data to score your recovery every morning and adapt today's workout — like WHOOP and Google Fit.
health.noWatch: Without a watch we only read steps from your phone. Recovery needs a watch that tracks heart rate and sleep.

adapt.red: Low recovery — we trimmed the volume and swapped cardio for an easy walk
adapt.yellow: Moderate recovery — one set less on accessory lifts
adapt.green: High recovery — go push it today 💪

health.privacy: Your raw health data stays private. Friends only see your step count, for step challenges.
health.unavailable: No health data source on this device. On Android, install Health Connect from Google Play.
health.watches_ios: Apple Watch · WHOOP · Oura · Garmin · Fitbit
health.watches_android: Pixel Watch · Galaxy Watch · Fitbit · WHOOP · Garmin · Oura
health.via_ios: Anything that writes to the Health app on iPhone
health.via_android: Anything that writes to Health Connect on Android
health.howBody: We compare this morning's HRV and resting heart rate with your personal 30-day baseline, and add your sleep performance versus your need. 67%+ = green, 34–66% = yellow, under 34% = red. Strain (0–21) comes from time in heart-rate zones (or active calories when zones are missing).
